user.title: NASCAR Race Center
user.description: Offline demonstration uses handmade sample data and makes no network requests. NASCAR CF is experimental and requires your confirmation of applicable data-use permission. This setting does not grant permission. Live behavior and anonymous endpoint access remain unverified. Polling slows automatically away from a current race; shorter intervals are not guaranteed to be permitted. Choose up to 50 favorites across all series. Search the cached directory by name, series, car number, team or NASCAR ID. You may also enter a known numeric NASCAR driver ID; unavailable metadata does not remove your favorites. Directory entries do not establish an active roster. You can enter known numeric IDs now, or choose favorites by name in options after the source-specific directory loads. Demonstration driver IDs are fictional.

data.data_use_authorized: I have confirmed permission to access and poll NASCAR CF data

data_description.favorite_drivers: Optional numeric NASCAR driver IDs. Choose favorites by name in options after the directory loads. Use NASCAR IDs, not car numbers; demonstration driver IDs are fictional.
data_description.racing_events: Off by default. Events only reach Home Assistant’s event bus. Enable an automation blueprint separately for notifications or lights.
data_description.event_types: Choose each event you want. A checkered flag means observed completion, not official final results. Starts require an observed lap-zero to green transition.
data_description.favorite_event_types: Applies to the saved favorite NASCAR driver IDs. Missing drivers never count as top-position changes. Pit observations require embedded lap and entry-clock evidence.
data_description.reminder_minutes: Only known offset-aware scheduled starts qualify. Setup inside a reminder window and recovered outages do not send catch-up reminders.
data_description.live_polling_policy: Adaptive timing supports 10-second offline/synthetic updates. CF retains its conservative cadence until permitted limits are independently verified; this option grants no NASCAR permission.
data_description.approaching_interval: Used for adaptive discovery within 30 minutes of a verified scheduled start. Provider and server limits take precedence.
data_description.live_interval: Conservative polling minimum (300–3600 seconds). Adaptive offline/synthetic mode uses its session targets. CF always retains this minimum and its existing schedule windows.

error.authorization_required: Confirm applicable data-use permission before selecting NASCAR CF.
error.invalid_series: Select at least one of series 1, 2 or 3.
error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number from 300 to 3600 seconds.
error.invalid_favorite_drivers: Select up to 50 drivers or enter positive numeric NASCAR driver IDs.
error.invalid_events: Choose supported events and whole numbers: top position 1–40, reminder 1–1440 minutes.
error.invalid_approaching_interval: Choose an integer from 30 to 60 seconds.

abort.already_configured: NASCAR Race Center is already configured. Use its options to change your selections.
